claim: Decoder-only warm-up before enabling an inherited head-only consumer was tested without replay and did not pass causal stable-prefix promotion gates.
retention_on_mastered_primitives: The frozen head remained unchanged and reloadable; the shared controller digest was unchanged in both medium arms.
reason_rejected: Warm-up improved target accuracy from 0.640625 to 0.671875 and restored consumer causality, but reward-shuffled accuracy rose to 0.71875, above the real target, and no stable consumer mastery prefix was observed.
